integrity.mathematical_evidence: Explicit all-graph proof from strongly regular adjacency quadratic relation, finite exact-rational checker of 333 edge columns on eight graphs.

scientific_limitations: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections only; no minimization over nonorthogonal projections.
Connected noncomplete unweighted strongly regular graphs with positive nonadjacent codegree; real l1 and linfinity endpoint operator norms only.
Local invariant tau_star requires induced-subgraph information, not determined by adjacency spectrum.
Residual possibility of equivalent calculations in less-indexed electrical-network literature.
title: Local-edge formula and spectral separation of cut–cycle endpoint norms in strongly regular graphs
